split.title: Backend ↔ Frontend in 30 seconds
split.back: Python 3.11+ · FastAPI under /api/v1/ · Pydantic v2 · SQLAlchemy 2 + SQLite + Alembic · 5 parsers (.docx, .pdf, .xlsx, .xml/S1000D, .csv) · 4 business checks (DMC coverage, Jaccard renames, consistency, illustrations) · Mistral API (chat + RAG embeddings + optional multimodal vision) · httpx async + SSE · structlog.
split.front: Preview HTML embedded in the backend (no Node) — vanilla JS · FR/EN i18n · Projects · Manager · Editor · Chatbot · Data · Settings views. Optional React + Vite build for richer UI.

arch.f2: Upload the DMC reference (.csv/.xlsx) expected by the client + the FTM files (.docx/.pdf/.xlsx/.xml/S1000D). Automatic SHA-256 versioning.
arch.f3: "Run analysis" → 4 sequential checks applied to the latest version of each file; anomalies are created with status open.
arch.f4: If Mistral is configured: RAG indexing (chunking + embeddings) stored in SQLite, to enable the chatbot.
arch.f5: Manager view: project KPIs. Editor view: anomalies grouped by file with suggestions. Chatbot: RAG Q&A with [file_name] citations.
arch.f6: Anomaly lifecycle: open → acknowledged → fixed (resolved) or rejected (false positive). CSV export anytime.
